overview: A single-page State Department cross-reference sheet concerning a report from Kobe dated August 25, 1937, about the shipment or employment of American citizens as seamen aboard foreign vessels at American ports. The sheet identifies Scott as the sender and directs researchers to decimal file 196.2/1005 for telegram or document no. 158 rather than preserving the underlying report here.

people.name: Scott
people.role: Sender of the report from Kobe

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to Scott report on American seamen aboard foreign vessels
subfiles.about: The sheet refers researchers to another file for a report about shipping American citizens as seamen on foreign vessels at American ports.
subfiles.summary: This filing note records a communication sent from Kobe by Scott on August 25, 1937. Its subject is the shipment of American citizens as seamen aboard foreign vessels at American ports. The substantive document, identified as no. 158, was filed under reference 196.2/1005.

interest: The sheet is useful chiefly as evidence of State Department filing practices: a maritime-labor report found under the Japan decimal file was redirected to another subject file. It also points historians to a potentially substantive missing document on Americans serving aboard foreign-flag vessels during the opening phase of the Second Sino-Japanese War.
